{{Quote|You're listening to the Grand Army of the Republic broadcast, the voice of the Outer Rim. This next one goes out to the Mud-Jumpers of the 224th, slugging it out on Mimban. Keep your heads down and your seals tight, boys.|Bettie-Bot VJ|audio=BettieBotVJ-Rookies.flac|<ref name="rookies" />}}
A '''battle''' took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] unit, the [[224th]], was dispatched to the planet. During the battle, [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Sharp]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] was shot in the [[Throat/Legends|throat]]. The [[Mud Jumpers/Legends|Mud-Jumpers]] of the 224th, while fighting on Mimban, received a shout-out from the [[Bettie-Bot VJ|host]] of a Republic [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] channel broadcast.

==The battle==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Rookies Date" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] unit known as the [[224th]] was dispatched to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]].<ref name="rookies" /> During the battle, [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Sharp]], who was serving with the Republic forces on Mimban, was injured when a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolt hit his [[Throat/Legends|throat]]. The bolt distorted his voice, and he later told [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] what had happened on Mimban during a [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|battle]] on the planet [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]].<ref name="Service" />

The [[Mud Jumpers/Legends|Mud-Jumpers]] of the 224th received a shout-out from<ref name="rookies" /> [[Bettie-Bot VJ]],<ref name="ep guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode005.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Rookies}}</ref> the host of a Republic [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] channel broadcast, during their fight on Mimban. Their shout-out was heard by a group of rookie [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]]&mdash;[[Echo/Legends|Echo]], [[Hevy/Legends|Hevy]], [[Fives/Legends|Fives]], and [[Cutup/Legends|Cutup]]&mdash;who were listening to the broadcast while maintaining a [[Rishi Station/Legends|listening post]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]].<ref name="rookies" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was first mentioned in "[[Rookies (episode)|Rookies]]," the fifth episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. The mention of the battle was minimal, only revealing that the 224th and Mud-Jumpers were fighting for the Republic.<ref name="ep guide" /> In the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] [[The Clone Wars 7|''The Clone Wars'' 7]], it was revealed that [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Sharp served in the battle and was injured.
